name: empty-state
description: A standalone empty-state block: optional icon, message, optional action button. For non-table-row empty states (a paper-preview with nothing selected, a set table with no blocks yet) -- a table-row-shaped empty cell should keep using table-cell's own type="empty-state" instead.

props.name: message
props.description: The empty-state text. Reuses table-cell's own Penpot-sourced empty-state string/typography as the default.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon name (matches an icons/<name>.svg file), shown above the message.

props.name: action_label
props.description: Optional action button label (e.g. "Add project"). Composes a real text-button instance (secondary, dotted underline -- the action stays on the current view, it doesn't navigate). Omit for a message-only empty state.

props.name: size
props.description: "row": a 44px row for an empty table or block list (centered caption at half opacity, hairline under it).

rationale:
The design source has no standalone empty-state component. table-cell's type="empty-state" is sourced, but is shaped as one table-row cell (no icon or action slot), so it can't represent an empty preview, picker or pane. This component reuses table-cell's sourced message styling (bodyTextItalic, text.subactive) and adds only the layout a cell can't offer: a centered column with an optional icon above the message and an optional action (a real text-button, declared in `uses`) below it. The icon size (spacing-8, 32px) is a judgment call, not sourced: larger than inline spacing-7 glyphs because it heads a standalone block. The action is secondary / dotted because adding something from an empty state happens in place rather than navigating away.

Sizes, from the application's Figma screens:
- data-size="row": the empty row under a table head or block list. One table row high (spacing.row plus the hairline), the caption role (Inter Italic 16px) in text.active, the whole row including its hairline at 50% opacity; the hairline is base/150 in light and the pressed surface in dark.
- data-size="block": the empty area inside a picker. Fills its row, 40px above and below, caption role at half opacity, on the pressed surface (base/50 in light).
- data-size="text": one plain left-aligned line at half opacity on the surface color, inset spacing.cell, no height or hairline of its own.
- data-size="fill": the empty box of a preview pane. Absolutely positioned 20px inside its positioned parent, filled with base.175 (a palette token, the same in both themes), a hairline on its left edge, the message centered, the whole box at half opacity.
Rendering verified in light and dark themes.
a11y_notes: The icon is aria-hidden: the message already carries the full meaning. The action is a real, focusable <button> from text-button's template, with no accessibility gap beyond what that component documents.
